svg.text: Secondary sleeve, retention and assembly limitations
STATIONARY-R1 | mm | 2026-10-23 | unchanged core / trunk / endcaps | CONDITIONAL PROTOTYPE
NOT A MAINS FABRICATION RELEASE - insulation / solder process / assembly / retention / thermal / endcaps UNMET
Finite max-OD wire / split sleeve
Tensility30-02075: OD1.5 +/-0.10, solid20AWG
Source minimum bend R9; each formed length54.462
plus2.600 bare tail. No ampacity / fault I2t grant.
Geometric screen is deliberately bounded
Wire / sleeve sampled minimum gap: 0.0112 mm.
Sleeve tube OD3.90 / ID3.70; proposed IDmin3.65.
Forming R9..9.1 and common XY placement +/-0.02 are
fixture allocations, not wire/sleeve supplier guarantees.
Sleeve split, wall0.10, burr coverage and retention UNMET.
Maximum jackets touch each other; no wire/core contact.
Adjustable jaws and bore shoes: no core penetration.
Thread/torque/friction/creep and pull strength UNMET.
Required assembly sequence - motion NOT proven
1. Set board/module/jaws on sled outside tube.
2. Insert sled before forming the secondary loop.
3. Feed ends, form with end-access jig, fit split sleeve.
4. Complete clamp, inspect terminations, pull/isolation test.
5. Close parent-owned endcaps / primary harness design.
The verifier proves a preformed loop cannot slide axially
into the intact core. Jig access, removal and forming
loads are still UNMET; the completed CAD pose does not
prove a buildable assembly sequence.
MEAN WELL generic PCB installation guide: 5 mm bottom insulation distance plus film, 10 mm around unit. These
are not qualified by this tight layout. Module/body source approval is not barrel safety approval. Thermal/line
derating in the sealed barrel, primary wiring, PE policy, variants and endcap clearances remain parent
integration gates.
See DESIGN.md, checks.json, pair-checks.json and receipt.json for explicit assumptions and acceptance limits.
